A_leak_test.method:
A.2 Neighbour leak test and candidate SAP-vs-PSF depth.
Box depth in a 3.0 h window at P=40.29109 d, t0=135.788 BKJD, after a 2-day running median (transits masked) per quarter.
depth = mean(out) - mean(in); out = 1..3 durations from mid-transit; formal error = std(out)*sqrt(1/N_in+1/N_out);
inflated by the scatter of 100 control phases (phase 0.03..0.97).

neighbour_expectation.note: Leak case: candidate light fully mixed into the target aperture gives at most D*Fc/(Fc+Ft); in reality the target's optimal aperture holds only part of the candidate's light 11.5 arcsec (2.9 px) away, so less. On-target case: a target dip D_t leaking a fraction e of the target flux into the candidate photometry gives D_c = D_t*e*Ft/(Fc+e*Ft) < D_t, so D_t > 2165 ppm.

A4_centroid_test_INVALID.method:
A.4 (extension): in-transit centroid shift of the candidate from the per-quarter CENTROID_COLUMN / CENTROID_ROW
columns of its KBonus file (read-only cache). Per quarter: subtract a 2-day running median (transits masked),
take mean(in) - mean(out) with the same 3.0 h / 1-3 duration windows as the depth test. Quarters of one season share the
CCD orientation, so they are averaged per season (inverse-variance). Implied offset of the dip source from the
out-of-transit centroid = -shift / depth (depth = SAP depth of that season), in pixels and arcsec (3.98 arcsec/px).
A4_centroid_test_INVALID.verdict: NOT USABLE: the KBonus CENTROID_COLUMN/ROW of the candidate and of KIC 6146666 move identically (difference scatter ~1e-6 px, correlation 1.0), i.e. they are the PSF-model positions (catalogue position plus a common pointing model), not flux-weighted centroids. They cannot respond to a dip, so the near-zero shifts below carry no information about the location of the dip source.
